name: Browser pane
responsibility: The pane a user works in: it names its tab session, holds the tab's lease, sends commands and draws the published state

outgoing.label: each socket names its tab, and its close forgets it
outgoing.description: The browser reaches the handled WebSocket route. websocket-connection.ts calls noteTabSession inside the Archboard server; no browser imports the private tab-sessions file.

outgoing.label: the person activated a checkout (/api/panes/conversation)
outgoing.description: A focus, a board the person opened or a pick from the dock's list names the checkout whose conversation the tab shows. shown-conversation-route.ts calls showConversation inside the Archboard server; no browser imports the private tab-sessions file.
